items.title: Buddy Collette interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: I had worked with some of those guys, especially with Benny I had worked with him... Benny did the music and I played the tenor... We did one thing called... 'The Lee Wiley Story.'

ctx.x: Every now and then, let’s see, Benny Carter would put a band together to go to Japan or somewhere, or he would do some jobs.
